capabilities.description: Forwards each profile's Silo notifications to Pushover, and playback, watchdog and failure alerts to admins who turn them on.

Checks Silo's stream nodes, restart state, database and Redis, and the server's disk and memory, and sends a Pushover alert (and a recovery alert) to admins who turned it on. Needs the read-only Silo key. Suggested schedule: every 5 minutes.
Sends admins who turned it on a Pushover summary of the last 7 days: plays, time watched, top viewers and top titles. Needs the read-only Silo key. Suggested schedule: weekly, Sunday 18:00.

global_config_schema.title: Pushover
global_config_schema.description: Server-wide settings. Each profile adds its own Pushover user key from Apps > Pushover.

fields.label: Shared Pushover application token (optional)
fields.description: Used for profiles that don't enter their own application token. Leave blank to require every profile to bring its own. Pushover limits each application to 10,000 messages a month.

fields.label: Public URL override (optional)
fields.description: Base URL for "Open in Silo" links. Defaults to the server's configured public URL.

fields.label: Read-only Silo key (admin:monitor:read)
fields.description: Optional. An API key created on an admin account with only the admin:monitor:read scope. With it, each account's primary profile can set up Pushover for every profile on the account. Without it, each profile sets up its own. "Set up the read-only key" on the Pushover page fills this in for you. Don't use a full-access key.

fields.label: Session control key (admin:sessions:control)
fields.description: Optional. An API key created on an admin account with the admin:sessions:control scope, for stopping streams from an alert. It can be the same key as above if that key has both scopes. Not used yet.

sections.title: Silo API keys (optional)
sections.description: Scoped keys let the plugin read from Silo without full admin access. Silo's API Keys page creates only full-access keys, so the easiest way to get these is to open Apps > Pushover as an admin and use "Set up the read-only key": paste a full-access key once and the plugin creates the scoped keys, saves them here and can revoke the full-access key.

presentation.summary: Send each profile's Silo notifications to Pushover.
presentation.description_markdown: Delivers Silo's per-profile notifications (new episodes and request updates) to Pushover, with per-profile keys, devices, sounds, priorities and message wording.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Optionally register an application at https://pushover.net/apps and paste its token into **Shared Pushover application token**. Without one, each profile must enter its own.
2. Optionally give the plugin a **read-only Silo key** (scope `admin:monitor:read`) so each account's primary profile can set up every profile on the account. Silo's API Keys page makes only full-access keys, so open **Apps > Pushover** as an admin, paste a full-access key into **Set up the read-only key**, and the plugin creates the scoped key, saves it, and can revoke the key you pasted.
3. Each profile opens **Apps > Pushover** to add their Pushover user key and choose which notifications to receive.
4. Optional scheduled alerts, the **server health check** and the **weekly digest**, need the read-only key and an admin switching them on under **Apps > Pushover**. Silo runs a plugin's scheduled task only on a schedule you give it: open **Admin > Plugins**, open Pushover Notifications and bind the tasks, or call `PUT /api/v2/admin/plugins/installations/{id}/task-bindings/{capability_id}` with an admin API key. For `health_check` (suggested: every 5 minutes) send `{"enabled": true, "trigger": {"type": "interval", "interval_ms": 300000}}`. For `weekly_digest` (suggested: Sunday 18:00, in the server's time zone) send `{"enabled": true, "trigger": {"type": "weekly", "day_of_week": 0, "time_of_day": "18:00"}}`. **Silo must be restarted after you change a task binding.** Until a task is bound, Silo runs it once each time it starts.

Upgrading from 0.2.0: the full-access key it asked for is no longer used. Open **Apps > Pushover** as an admin and click **Replace the old full-access key**: the plugin uses it once to create the read-only key, then revokes it.
